## ProgressLinear.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: Current progress value, or `null`/`undefined` for indeterminate motion.
- `min` :: Lower bound of the range.
- `max` :: Upper bound of the range.
- `tone` :: Semantic color accent.
- `size` :: Scale controlling label text and track thickness.
- `shape` :: Track and fill corner shape.
- `gap` :: The space between the label row and the track.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the label and the value.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the label. Defaults to `text-secondary`.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the value readout. Defaults to `text-muted`.
- `striped` :: Draw diagonal stripes across the fill bar.
- `animated` :: Animate the diagonal stripes along the fill.
- `showValue` :: Display formatted progress percentage beside the label.
- `label` :: Visible label and accessible name for the progress bar.
- `formatValue` :: Optional formatter for the displayed value readout.
